g.title: j4274146200
g.text: Arthur, can we talk? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]

g.title: j166811000
g.text: No, not really. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.

g.title: j3325977307
g.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.

g.title: j3593855103
g.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.

g.title: j2657090727
g.text: Ah. I can see where this is going. You have feelings for someone else as well?

g.title: j4067146223
g.text: I do. And I know it might be hard to understand, but it doesn't mean I feel any less for you.

g.title: j75309401
g.text: I do. But now that I think about it, I think we should probably end things here. [Break up.]

g.title: j1822483119
g.text: Darling, do you honestly think I spent so many years in the military and haven't seen just about every kind of relationship there is?

g.title: j1569307400
g.text: If that's what you really want, then...

g.title: j62326312
g.text: When you spend so much of your life nearly dying, you learn to appreciate what matters in life and what doesn't.

g.title: j54733247
g.text: You stop questioning lines in the sand. I completely understand.

g.title: j659609868
g.text: Fact of the matter is? You matter to me. And if they matter to you, then they matter to me.

g.title: j3854110948
g.text: Just. Not. Not the Hex. All right? I don't think I could handle it if it were in "the family," so to speak.

g.title: j434365877
g.text: Thought of it's going to give me nightmares.

g.title: j132739687
g.text: For what it's worth, I really think you would like them.

g.title: j4290746634
g.text: Thanks. And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.

g.title: j3529239156
g.text: And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.

g.title: j3290621093
g.text: Just take care of yourself out there, love.
